pitch_en: Develops biomimetic low-wind-speed turbines inspired by Amazonian tree seeds, enabling distributed renewable energy for rural and off-grid communities in Colombia.
pitch_es: Desarrolla turbinas de baja velocidad del viento inspiradas en semillas de árboles amazónicos, habilitando energía renovable distribuida para comunidades rurales y aisladas en Colombia.
cta_pitch_en: Develops biomimetic low-wind-speed turbines inspired by Amazonian tree seeds, enabling distributed renewable energy for rural and off-grid communities in Colombia.
cta_pitch_es: Desarrolla turbinas de baja velocidad del viento inspiradas en semillas de árboles amazónicos, habilitando energía renovable distribuida para comunidades rurales y aisladas en Colombia.

sections.head_en: Conventional small wind turbines underperform at moderate wind speeds (4–7 m/s), leaving most industrial and rural sites without viable distributed wind generation.
sections.head_es: Las turbinas eólicas pequeñas convencionales rinden poco a velocidades moderadas (4–7 m/s), dejando a la mayoría de sitios industriales y rurales sin generación eólica distribuida viable.
sections.body_en: Conventional small wind turbines underperform at moderate wind speeds (4–7 m/s), leaving most industrial and rural sites without viable distributed wind generation.

steps.text_en: Bioseed bio-inspired axial turbines and distributed-wind deployment models (including behind-the-meter industrial use).
steps.text_es: Turbinas axiales Bioseed bio-inspiradas y modelos de despliegue de viento distribuido (incluyendo uso industrial behind-the-meter).
